Spreader Beams

> Spreader beams, the backbone of our lifting equipment.  These beams are used to distribute (or
> ‘spread’) the load of a heavy item being lifted by a crane. A spreader beam puts a compressive
> stress on the beam as opposed to a bending stress. It is designed to keep the slings below the
> beam at a 90 degree angle to avoid the load being damaged. The weight of the load being lifted is
> equally distributed between the two bottom slings when the centre of gravity is central. 
> 
> With customisable features such as cone adaptors, stepdown end units, clevis drop-links and
> trunnion end units, spreader beams excel in handling diverse weights and sizes. They’re versatile
> and adaptable, catering to a wide spectrum of industries, from construction and renewable energy
> to breakbulk and ports.

> restricted headroom.

> frames for multi-point lifts including the 4-, 6- or 8-point CMOD frame and the 3-point TrMOD
> spreader frame.

### NEW & USED
### Container Conditions

#### New Shipping Containers

**New shipping containers, **aka 1-trip containers, may have a few minor scratches or dents, but
they have only made the journey overseas once. Each container is surveyed and inspected to IICL
standards.

[New-One-Trip-Container]

#### Used Shipping Containers

**Cargo Worthy (CW)** are used, but they can be suitable for cargo transportation. They are
structurally sound and wind/watertight but will have minor dents, scratches, and rust. CW containers
will need a valid CSC inspection sticker for overseas shipping.

**Wind & Water Tight (WWT)** can no longer pass certification for cargo transportation. When they
are approx. 10-20 years old and retired from overseas shipments, they can still be used for many
domestic applications. They will have superficial dents, scratches, and surface rust but are in good
condition, weatherproof, and structurally sound.

**As Is** containers are no longer wind and water tight and could have internal and external issues
such as floor damage, holes, or other fixable repairs.

[20-ft shipping containers used]

## Shipping & Storage Containers for All Your Needs

### Buy New or Used Containers

Advanced Container Co. supplies [second-hand and new cargo-worthy steel shipping and storage
containers][87] in a range of sizes and configurations. We sell steel containers locally in Houston,
around the Gulf Coast, and worldwide.

**Shipping Containers**: There are numerous types of shipping containers, but 95% are what are
termed dry containers, which carry general freight. There are also refrigerated units designed for
transporting frozen or chilled cargo and specialty steel boxes, many of which are specifically
designed for certain cargo. All shipping containers must conform to international standards such as
ISO, UIC, TIR, and CSC, and Advanced Container can advise you on the right type of container for
your specific needs.

**Steel Storage Containers** provide dry, theft and vandal proof storage solution for a variety of
purposes including office equipment, tools, materials, and more.

### NEW & USED
### Container Conditions

#### New Shipping Containers

**New shipping containers, **aka 1-trip containers, may have a few minor scratches or dents, but
they have only made the journey overseas once. Each container is surveyed and inspected to IICL
standards.

[New-One-Trip-Container]

#### Used Shipping Containers

**Cargo Worthy (CW)** are used, but they can be suitable for cargo transportation. They are
structurally sound and wind/watertight but will have minor dents, scratches, and rust. CW containers
will need a valid CSC inspection sticker for overseas shipping.

**Wind & Water Tight (WWT)** can no longer pass certification for cargo transportation. When they
are approx. 10-20 years old and retired from overseas shipments, they can still be used for many
domestic applications. They will have superficial dents, scratches, and surface rust but are in good
condition, weatherproof, and structurally sound.

**As Is** containers are no longer wind and water tight and could have internal and external issues
such as floor damage, holes, or other fixable repairs.

## Akel Ship & Offshore Industry

### What We Do

Akel manufactures tailor-made cargo carrying units, pressure vessels and offshore containers.

[Explore Our Solutions][6]

## Industries We Serve

With our office and factory located in Türkiye, we proudly serve global sales and rental markets —
delivering cost-efficient production that meets the rigorous standards of the North Sea
Offshore Industry.

#### **Offshore & Industrial Containers by AKEL**

AKEL designs and delivers a diverse range of containers and equipment for offshore and industrial
applications — from tailor-made solutions to mass production.
Our product lineup includes:
* Shore Containers
* Offshore Containers
* Mud Skips
* Pipe Baskets
* Hydraulic Power Units (HPUs)
* Topside Umbilical Termination Units (TUTUs)
* Base Frames

All products are manufactured using high-performance materials such as: ***Stainless Steel, Duplex,
Lean Duplex, Super Duplex, 6Mo Stainless Steel, Titanium, and Aluminium.***
We ensure full compliance with international offshore standards and client specifications.

#### Offshore Industry Equipment

AKEL specializes in the production of custom offshore industrial equipment and components. We
manufacture high-quality steel and stainless steel products tailored to client specifications,
adhering to the rigorous standards required for North Sea operations. Our expertise spans from
one-off builds to larger series production runs. This demonstrates our versatility and commitment to
quality in the offshore sector.
Examples of our delivered equipment include:
* High-pressure Vessels
* Filter Units
* Spuds and Pillars
* Deck Outfitting Equipment
* Strong Points
* Rollers
* A-frames

## Solar Container Technology

Advanced solar containers provide complete plug-and-play energy solutions in standardized shipping
container formats. Our container solutions include 20ft and 40ft configurations with integrated
solar power systems, battery storage, and power conversion equipment. These self-contained units
feature: High-efficiency solar panels mounted on container roofs or folding systems; Integrated
lithium-ion battery storage from 100kWh to 1MWh capacity; Built-in climate control and thermal
management systems; Advanced monitoring and control systems for remote operation; Rapid deployment
capabilities with minimal site preparation. Our solar containers are designed for mining operations,
remote communities, construction sites, emergency power, and grid support applications, providing
reliable electricity anywhere it's needed.

## Energy Storage Container Systems

Energy storage containers provide scalable, mobile power solutions in standardized 20ft and 40ft
configurations. Our containerized storage systems feature advanced battery technology with
capacities ranging from 500kWh to 3MWh per container. Key features include: Modular design allowing
multiple container interconnection; Advanced battery management systems ensuring safety and
longevity; Grid-forming capabilities for island operation and microgrids; Integrated power
conversion systems with high round-trip efficiency; Thermal management systems maintaining optimal
operating temperatures; Rapid deployment with plug-and-play connectivity. Our energy storage
containers are ideal for peak shaving, frequency regulation, renewable energy integration, backup
power, and mobile power applications across commercial, industrial, and utility sectors.

## Solar Container Technology

Advanced solar containers provide complete plug-and-play energy solutions in standardized shipping
container formats. Our container solutions include 20ft and 40ft configurations with integrated
solar power systems, battery storage, and power conversion equipment. These self-contained units
feature: High-efficiency solar panels mounted on container roofs or folding systems; Integrated
lithium-ion battery storage from 100kWh to 1MWh capacity; Built-in climate control and thermal
management systems; Advanced monitoring and control systems for remote operation; Rapid deployment
capabilities with minimal site preparation. Our solar containers are designed for mining operations,
remote communities, construction sites, emergency power, and grid support applications, providing
reliable electricity anywhere it's needed.

## Energy Storage Container Systems

Energy storage containers provide scalable, mobile power solutions in standardized 20ft and 40ft
configurations. Our containerized storage systems feature advanced battery technology with
capacities ranging from 500kWh to 3MWh per container. Key features include: Modular design allowing
multiple container interconnection; Advanced battery management systems ensuring safety and
longevity; Grid-forming capabilities for island operation and microgrids; Integrated power
conversion systems with high round-trip efficiency; Thermal management systems maintaining optimal
operating temperatures; Rapid deployment with plug-and-play connectivity. Our energy storage
containers are ideal for peak shaving, frequency regulation, renewable energy integration, backup
power, and mobile power applications across commercial, industrial, and utility sectors.

Мы несем ответственность за гарантийные обязательства, качество и сроки поставки, а также занимаемся

ПРОИЗВОДСТВО

Лидерство в области промышленных решений

CIMC ENRIC  – это ведущий мировой производитель оборудования для хранения и транспортировки жидких,
газообразных и химических веществ. Компания также предоставляет решения для энергетики, химической
промышленности и пищевого сектора. Рассмотрим основные аспекты производства и особенностей CIMC
ENRIC.

Постоянное совершенствование технологий, высокий уровень качества и ориентация на глобальные
потребности позволяют компании занимать лидирующие позиции на рынке. Это делает CIMC ENRIC ключевым
партнером в развитии экологически чистых и эффективных решений для хранения и транспортировки.

**Хранения и транспортировки сжиженных газов**: Производство резервуаров для сжиженного природного
газа (СПГ), пропан-бутана (LPG), водорода и других промышленных газов.

**Химическая промышленность**: Создание емкостей и цистерн для транспортировки агрессивных
химических веществ.

**Пищевая промышленность**: Выпуск оборудования для транспортировки и хранения жидких продуктов,
таких как молоко, пиво и соки.

НАШИ ПОСТОЯННЫЕ КЛИЕНТЫ

CIMC ENRIC

CIMC Enric является ведущим предприятием в мировой индустрии танк-контейнеров с самым большим
производственным масштабом, наиболее полным и всеобъемлющим портфелем продуктов и самой обширной
цепочкой обслуживания.

Компания является первым производителем танк-контейнеров в Китае с независимыми правами
интеллектуальной собственности. Объемы производства и продаж танк-контейнеров CIMC уже более десяти
лет подряд занимают лидирующие позиции в мире.

**ООО «СНАБАРМАТУРА» ГОТОВА ЗАКЛЮЧИТЬ ДОГОВОР И ПРИНИМАТЬ ОПЛАТУ В РОССИЙСКОЙ ВАЛЮТЕ**

Мы несем ответственность за гарантийные обязательства, качество и сроки поставки, а также занимаемся
растаможкой, предоставляем логистические услуги и все необходимые технические и разрешительные
документы в соответствии с законодательством Российской Федерации.

ПРОИЗВОДСТВО

Лидерство в области промышленных решений

CIMC ENRIC  – это ведущий мировой производитель оборудования для хранения и транспортировки жидких,
газообразных и химических веществ. Компания также предоставляет решения для энергетики, химической
промышленности и пищевого сектора. Рассмотрим основные аспекты производства и особенностей CIMC
ENRIC.

Постоянное совершенствование технологий, высокий уровень качества и ориентация на глобальные
потребности позволяют компании занимать лидирующие позиции на рынке. Это делает CIMC ENRIC ключевым
партнером в развитии экологически чистых и эффективных решений для хранения и транспортировки.

**Хранения и транспортировки сжиженных газов**: Производство резервуаров для сжиженного природного
газа (СПГ), пропан-бутана (LPG), водорода и других промышленных газов.

**Химическая промышленность**: Создание емкостей и цистерн для транспортировки агрессивных
химических веществ.

**Пищевая промышленность**: Выпуск оборудования для транспортировки и хранения жидких продуктов,
таких как молоко, пиво и соки.

servicing multiple applications in the clean energy and industrial gas markets. Our unique product

service and repair.

# Africa’s Trusted Offshore Shipping Containers Supplier

[united-kingdom]

### Certified Offshore Containers, Reefers, Baskets & Modules for Africa

Container World has been providing specialised container conversions into the African on-shore
market since 1983. With growing demand from our long term on-shore customers, we have recently
expanded our product range and are now able to offer a wide variety of off-shore containers,
baskets, skips, reefers and accommodation modules, all certified to DNV 2.7-1 and EN 12079.

Strategically located in Cape Town and with most units available Ex Stock, we are well placed to be
able to service demand from both East and West Africa with short lead times and at competitive
prices.

Our on-shore division remains a leading supplier of converted containers, including accommodation,
dining, kitchen, ablution, and office units to the African Market.

With more than 32 years of experience servicing the African market and with 12 strategically located
branches, Container World is ideally positioned and experienced to handle any on, or off-shore
container enquiry.

[Read More][11]
[france]

### Votre Expert en Conteneurs Onshore et Offshore en Afrique

Container world est une Société basée en Afrique du Sud, fournissant depuis 1983 le continent
africain avec des conteneurs spécialement modifiés. À la demande express de nos clients, nous avons
récemment élargi notre gamme de produits. Nous sommes désormais capables d’offrir un large éventail
de conteneurs offshore comme : paniers, bennes, frigos et modules de logement, tous certifiés DNV
2.7-1 et EN 12079.

Stratégiquement basés à Cape Town, nous sommes à même de répondre aux demandes émanant tant de
l’Afrique de l’Ouest que de l’Est. Les produits étant pour la plupart en stock, cela nous permet de
réduire nos délais de livraison et d’être compétitifs.

Notre division on-shore reste et demeure notre principale activité pour le marché africain. Nous
fournissons une gamme complète de conteneurs convertis, tels que : logements, réfectoires, cuisines,
installations sanitaires et bureaux.

Avec plus de 32 ans d’expérience et nos douze bureaux idéalement localisés pour servir le continent
africain, Container World est votre partenaire expert, prêt à répondre à toutes vos demandes de
conteneurs on-shore et offshore.

[Read More][12]
[portugal]

### Líder em Contentores Convertidos em África desde 1983

ContainerWorld é uma sociedade comercial com bases e sede na República da África do Sul, que tem
estado a abastecer e fornecer o mercado Africano, com a conversão especializada de contentores desde
o ano de 1983. Com uma procura intensa e crescente dos nossos clientes, nós procedemos recentemente
a uma profunda expansão da nossa gama de produtos e estamos presentemente aptos a oferecer uma
variedade ampla dos nossos contentores para o África como cestos, caçambas, alcatruzes,
compartimentos refrigerados e módulos de acomodação, todos devidamente certificados através dos DNV
2.7-1 e EN 12079.

Estrategicamente situada na Cidade do Cabo e com o maior número de unidades prontas e disponíveis do
nosso estoque, nós estamos bem preparados para atender qualquer demanda ou procura de serviço, quer
do continente africano do leste, quer do oeste, com prazos curtos de entrega e preços altamente
competitivos. A nossa principal atividade continua a ser a fornecedora de contentores convertidos,
incluindo secções de acomodação, de jantar, de cozinha, ablução e unidades de escritório para o
mercado africano.

Com mais de 35 anos de experiência comprovada, prestando serviço ao mercado africano e com 12
sucursais estrategicamente situadas, a Container World está idealmente posicionada e experiente para
atender qualquer pedido de contentores onshore e offshore.

concept, design, fabrication, client & project management services. We recognise that our success

## Certified quality

ELA Container Offshore is an [ISO 9001:2015][70] and [ISO 45001:2023][71] certified company.
Depending on their area of use and purpose, the high-quality containers are certified according to
ISO 10855 / EN 12079-1 / DNV2.7-1, DNV 2.7-2, DNV 2.7-3 and/or CSC.

Offshore containers by ELA Offshore – fast, flexible and ready to use

ELA Container Offshore supplies container modules especially designed for the offshore industry.
Thanks to our long-term experience in building container solutions, we have succeeded in developing
a wide range of offshore **container types for rent and for sale.**
 

Benefits of ELA Offshore Containers

Our mobile offshore units are available at short notice, individually customizable, fully equipped
and ready for immediate use.


Whether used as accommodations to house the offshore crew, just to transport items from A to B, or
fully customized to meet the exacting requirements of a specific job, offshore certified containers
have proven to be a perfect space solution for [offshore platforms, ships or barges.][72] The
offshore modules are **designed for multi-modal transport, can be sea-fastened quickly and are
stackable over multiple levels.** Furthermore, offshore containers are **specially coated to
withstand the harsh conditions at sea.**

Temporary offshore containers or long-term containerized solutions

In the offshore industry, requirements may change rapidly and one must be able to respond quickly.
If you only need your containers temporary, we recommend the rental option because you only pay for
what you need and as long you need it. About 80 per cent of our customers therefore prefer to rent
the containers for a certain period and they are **typically rented for a period of 2 to 8 months.**

# Offshore logistics for the oil industry South-America

**ECL offers a unique liner service between Europe, the southern Caribbean and the north coast of
South America. The liner service is suitable for the transportation of project cargo, break bulk,
dry bulk, and vehicles in all shapes and sizes.**

To this aim, the monthly South Caribbean Service with our multi-purpose vessels sails from Antwerp,
Hull, and Gijon to [Georgetown][60] and [Paramaribo][61], Point Lisas, and Matanzas. Every two
weeks, we offer sailings from Vlissingen to Georgetown and Paramaribo with our Reefer Service. This
service yields the fastest transit times. Efficient, reliable, and predictable.

### ECL was founded in 1981 in Willemstad, Curacao.

The Caribbean liner service arose from a partnership between [Vertraco Shipping B.V.][62] and
[Vertom Shipping & Trading B.V.][63] Our years of experience result in specialised knowledge of
various types of cargo. Feel free to ask our advice

# Offshore Reefer Container

## DNV 2.7-1 Certified & Immediate Stock Available for Purchase

## What is an offshore reefer container?

Offshore reefer containers (also known as Offshore refrigerated containers) are used within the
shipping industry to transport temperature-sensitive products that need refrigeration. Within the
oil and gas industry, they are also popularly known as “skids.”

MGS offshore reefer containers have data monitoring systems, automated temperature and ventilation
control, offering complete reliability in supplying perishable products to offshore locations.

At MGS Offshore, we offer two DNV-certified reefer container models:
[Ice Wave][15] (8 feet)
[Ice Storm][16] (10 feet)

### Uses of offshore refrigerated containers

Our automated refrigerated containers can maintain temperature ranges as low as -60 degrees Celsius
(-76 degrees Fahrenheit). This is extremely important in the transportation of products like
pharmaceuticals, seafood, meats, fresh fruits, vegetables, flowers, and certain chemicals.

construction, retail, mining, and custom projects. Our inventory includes standard dry containers,

#### **Container Conversions & Custom Builds**

checks and regular maintenance. Our leasing program ensures flexibility, cost-efficiency, and
consistent access to well-maintained containers.


### **Domestic Leasing**

We also offer container rentals within South Africa and nearby regions, supplying one of the most
diverse fleets of locally compliant, duty-paid containers. Our domestic leasing division supports
businesses with short-term and long-term storage, on-site accommodation units, secure equipment
housing, and more. Each unit is inspected, serviced, and delivered ready for immediate use—ensuring
reliable performance throughout the rental period.

## Global Shipping Capabilities

right when you need them - so you can focus on the job, not the supply chain.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

### [Workshop with Crane][45]

Uniteam's Workshop with Crane is a certified offshore unit designed and manufactured in compliance
with DNV 2.7-1/EN12079 standards. Specifically designed for equipment and tool repairs, maintenance,
and storage, it stands stands as a secure and comfortable workspace tailored to the unique demands
of the oil and gas industry.
This specialized unit boasts a robust, high-strength steel workbench, ensuring a durable and
reliable surface for various tasks. Additionally, it incorporates custom-designed shelves or
cabinets, providing enhanced flexibility and organizational options to streamline operations.

General specification:
- DNV 2.7-1/EN12079 Certified
- High strong steel workbench with vice
- Crane capacity on request

amenities include 2 toilets and long stools for storing SCBA, portable gas detectors, and first aid
kits catering to 20 individuals.

### [Workshop with Crane][45]

Uniteam's Workshop with Crane is a certified offshore unit designed and manufactured in compliance
with DNV 2.7-1/EN12079 standards. Specifically designed for equipment and tool repairs, maintenance,
and storage, it stands stands as a secure and comfortable workspace tailored to the unique demands
of the oil and gas industry.
This specialized unit boasts a robust, high-strength steel workbench, ensuring a durable and
reliable surface for various tasks. Additionally, it incorporates custom-designed shelves or
cabinets, providing enhanced flexibility and organizational options to streamline operations.

General specification:
- DNV 2.7-1/EN12079 Certified
- High strong steel workbench with vice
- Crane capacity on request

[ Read more [arrow-right-red] ][46]
[
][47]

### [20 Men Blast Proof SIP / H2S Protection Shelter][48]

Uniteam’s 20-Men Blast Proof H2S Shelter is a tailored safety solution designed to safeguard
employees during hazardous events. Encased within a 1×50’ container boasting an A-60 fire rating, it
offers robust blast-proof protection with 690mbar for 20msec. Additionally, it features a compressed
fresh air breathing system capable of safeguarding employees for over 2 hours in emergencies. Its
F&G system and MIMIC panel ensure informative and correct warnings with a SIL-2 control system.
Notably, it incorporates Airlock Area and Battery Room with 25~50Pa overpressure. Also, there’s a
Muster Room and an Equipment Room with 50~75Pa overpressure. Within the approx.16.5 Sqm Muster Room,
amenities include 2 toilets and long stools for storing SCBA, portable gas detectors, and first aid
kits catering to 20 individuals.

General specification:
- Built for easy transport and relocation
- A-60 fire rating and blast-proof protection with 690mbar for 20msec
- 360-degree rotating camera on the roof monitors the external environment timely

[ Read more [arrow-right-red] ][49]
[
][50]

### [Lab Container][51]

Uniteam’s Offshore Mud Lab Container stands as a high-quality offshore module meticulously designed,
manufactured, and certified in accordance with DNV 2.7-1/EN 12079 standards. Consists of a container
body, fume hood cabinet, workbench, storage cabinet, air conditioner, transformer, water heater,
refrigerator, and more to meet the unique needs of each customer. Crafted for mud lab drilling, this
module ensures a secure and comfortable work environment for the oil & gas industry. By integrating
essential components and adhering to rigorous industry standards, it fulfills the stringent demands
of offshore operations.

General specification:
- DNV 2.7-1 / EN12079 Certified
- Design temperature: -20°C or -40°C
- Customized furniture
